about: The crypt's west-east bridge, 288 px long (docs/milestones/connected-biomes.md, CB13). Its floor a 64 px band of the causeway's stones laid across it, its sides a broken lip (crypt_edge) and an invisible wall (its void a wall). Its ends run to the template's edge, where its two sockets are. tools/ground_shape.py draws crypt_bridge_288_ground.tscn and its art from this.
